question: In India, white revolution is also known as ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Operation flood**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operation flood** is also known as the **white revolution** in India.
 
• It was started in **1970** by **Dr. Verghese Kurien**.
 
• **Dr. Verghese Kurien** is also known as the **Father of the white revolution** in India.
 
• The aim of **Operation flood** was to **make India self-sufficient in milk production** and to **increase the income of dairy farmers.**
 
• The program was successful in achieving its goals and India became the world's largest milk producer.
